recipe.text: 37-part primitive build. Walls = split Part segments around the door opening (lintel above) so the doorway is a real passable 7x4.5 hole. Gables = paired back-to-back WedgeParts at each side wall top; roof = two rotated slabs at atan(gableH/halfSpan) with overhang, ridge cap on top. Coherent palette: plaster walls, wood trim, slate roof, brick chimney, glass windows. Verified visually from 4 angles against Wikimedia cottage references.
